implementation_summary: Added four presentational components. They take props only and do no fetching, and they use Tailwind classes like the rest of the wizard. HierarchyView({hierarchy}) shows the page tree as a nested ul with title (or path plus 'No title') and how each page was placed. A repeated page is listed only once. Its navigation map is grouped Menu, Footer, Breadcrumb, Internal link; each group has a table of On page, Link text, Goes to and Where it sits. PageContentView({content}) shows title, description and language (detected, others, lang attribute as written), then Sections in page order (heading or kind label, own text via sectionText) and tables for headings with H-levels, images, links with where they sit plus 'Leaves the site', and CTAs. Image alt reads 'Alt text missing' for null alt and 'Empty alt (decorative image)' for an empty one. Forms show their fields and a note that they are read and never sent. PageFactsView({page, technology, signals}) shows language, SEO basics as Found/Not found facts, and accessibility basics as 'WCAG 2.2 level AA, automatic checks only' with the violation count; a non-Sample Page says it was not checked. It also shows the site's technology or 'Not identified', and a table of the marketing signals with Found/Not found/Not checked, pages and NAP. FindingsList({findings}) keeps the given order and shows title, page, Section (or 'Whole page'), all pages of a cross-page finding, impact, effort and source. AI findings get an advisory label. analysis-text.ts holds all the fixed wording and the empty-value fallbacks. It also has textLangAttrs, which sets lang (and dir=rtl for Urdu) on elements with text in the listed Indic or Arabic scripts, so Tamil text gets lang="ta" and is kept character for character. The UI text avoids 'region' and 'run'. All @qa/types imports go through @qa/types/src/browser.js. MarketingSignal comes from AuditMarketing['signals'][number] because aspects.ts is not re-exported there.
